C2A normalized field boundaries are provisional software calibration for detached candidates and are not universal geophysical thresholds.
Continental structural identity does not imply exposed land, and ocean-basin structural identity does not imply final water or depth.
D2 radial compact-support fields do not independently encode oriented margins, ridges, arcs, sutures, transforms, or elongated rift corridors.
Drowned continental affinity cannot be resolved from continental and oceanic influence alone without later material, thickness, buoyancy, and surface context.
Ghost-risk rules identify unsupported diagnostic patterns; they do not authorize deletion of causal records or modification of process fields.

Phase C structural interpretation cannot read legacy solved morphology, land-water masks, sea level, bathymetry, renderer color, UI labels, province IDs, debug identities, or shadow-audit comparison output.
Shelf and slope roles require later sedimentary, material, bathymetric, sea-level, and surface context and are not leading-role eligible in C2A.
The cited Earth systems establish broad structural relations and exceptions but do not prescribe generated-world region counts, exact geometry, or universal frequencies.
Wave 1 direct-input downstream sensitivity remains research-required, so C2A does not claim end-to-end scientific completion.
